segments.text: So let's take a moment to let our attention settle down,
slowly start to bring our focus within.
You can pay attention to your breath for a few moments
to help you calm down.
We can begin by placing both of our hands on the mother earth
and just allowing any heat, any heat from our body,
from our subtle system, our chakras or our channels,
To be absorbed by the Mother Earth and we can also take a moment to feel gratitude in our heart
for the nourishment that the Mother Earth provides that she takes care of us so generously
and we can settle our attention in the first energy center at the base of our spine
our Mooladhara and here we ask that we may develop childlike innocence and joy
Let our Mooladhara be strengthened and let the foundation of our subtle system be established.
Putting our hands back on our lap with our palms facing upward, we can slowly bring our attention up through the central channel,
through each of the chakras, and we can use our right hand to help us if we need, and like this we are expressing our desire.
That the Kundalini should awaken and should pass through each of our chakras and with her qualities
of cleansing. Like this we are inviting the Kundalini to clear any blockages from any of
our chakras. We can put our right hand back on the mother earth and guide our attention
to the left channel. Here we are going to detach from our past. We let it go. We let go of

Of any negative emotions, we let go of any thoughts about the past and we affirm within ourselves that the past is finished and now I would like to be here in the present and again we rely on the earth element to absorb any of the heaviness in our left channel.
We can bring our right hand back to our lap and raise the left hand in order to clear our right channel.
You can see how this is done on your screen.
So we guide our attention to the right channel and here we rely on the air element, on the ether,
to absorb all the excess heat in our right side and also to cool down our attention.
On our right channel we have to detach from our future.
We let go of all of our planning, all of our organizing, all of our thinking and imagining,
About the future can slowly bring our left hand back to our lap.
Now we bring our attention to our left heart and the left heart is the seat of our spirit.
And here we have to recognize that we have so many identifications and labels that we put on
ourselves, that society might put on us, that we gather throughout our life.
And we would like to detach from these identifications in order to truly discover our pure spirit.
So here we can affirm within ourselves, I am not this body, I am not this mind, I am not these conditionings, I am not any one of these labels.
I am the spirit. The pure spirit is what it is and it cannot be changed.
And it is here, in the present moment, we can also bring our attention and our hand to our center heart.
And through this energy center we express our love.
Here we can affirm within ourselves that our heart is full of love.
We can bring our attention to our Vishuddhi, which is the energy center in our throat.
And one of the aspects of this chakra
It gives us the ability to witness ourselves and the world around us without reacting, without engaging, but just to watch.
And we do this in a detached way.
So here we can ask that let me witness myself, my thoughts, my actions, my behaviors,
so that without reacting, without thinking, I can clear myself.
I can balance myself. This way we can also detach. We can not identify with any blockages on any of the chakras that we feel.
We can watch ourselves and desire that the kundalini may help us to clear our chakras.
We can bring both of our hands to either side of our head. On the left side of our head is our ego and on the right side of our head is our superego.
And these two aspects of our being influence all of our thoughts.
So to calm down our mind, here we try to let them both go.
Say, I am not this ego, I am not this superego, which is the conditionings.
We can even gently use our hands to bring down the left and the right side from our head
towards the earth. We can do this several times.
And now we gently bring our attention to the top of the head, to our Sahasrara. You can put your
hand there if you like, or you can leave both of your hands in your lap. And here we just take a
moment to watch our attention. Where is it going? Are we distracted by anything? And we just try to
bring it back inside ourselves and to the top of the head. Here we have to express our desire
That I would like to experience thoughtless awareness. I would like to be in thoughtless awareness.
I would like to feel the connection with the all-pervading power around me.
In this moment nothing else matters. Whatever happened before and whatever will happen later
do not exist. This moment right now is the reality and in this moment we would like to be thoughtless.

You may continue your meditation as long as you would like, just keeping your attention in the present moment, letting go of any thoughts and asking the Kundalini to help us keep our attention at the top of the head.
